name: grype

patches.old:
http_download() (
  log_debug "http_download(url=$2)"
  if is_command curl; then
    http_download_curl "$@"
    return
  elif is_command wget; then
    http_download_wget "$@"
    return
  fi
  log_err "http_download unable to find wget or curl"
  return 1
)

get_release_tag() (
  owner="$1"
  repo="$2"
  tag="$3"

  log_trace "get_release_tag(owner=${owner}, repo=${repo}, tag=${tag})"

  json=$(github_release_json "${owner}" "${repo}" "${tag}")
  real_tag=$(github_release_tag "${json}")
  if test -z "${real_tag}"; then
    return 1
  fi

  log_trace "get_release_tag() returned '${real_tag}'"

  echo "${real_tag}"
)

notes: Converts the official upstream installer; upstream source is fetched at a fixed commit rather than vendored.
Validates local effective configuration rendering. Vulnerability scanning requires an independently collected Grype database, which is not included or claimed.

The included official installer is fetched at the release tag commit, so the redundant release-script refetch is disabled. Upstream SHA-256 verification is preserved; optional cosign verification was not enabled in the original default.

validation_scope.runtime_scope: CLI installation and local operation; no remote service, cluster or deployment is claimed.
